# pantechdynamics_bucket (Data Source)

Looks up one S3-compatible object storage bucket by id or name, along with its live storage usage and tags. Deleted buckets are not found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing object storage bucket by name (or by id) to read its
# endpoint, live storage usage, and tags.
data "pantechdynamics_bucket" "uploads" {
  name = "acme-app-uploads"
}

output "uploads_endpoint" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_bucket.uploads.endpoint
}

output "uploads_size_bytes" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_bucket.uploads.size_bytes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the bucket, starting with bkt_. Set exactly one of id and name.
- `name` (String) Name of the bucket. Set exactly one of id and name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the bucket was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `endpoint` (String) The S3 endpoint URL for this bucket's region.
- `object_count` (Number) Live number of objects stored in the bucket.
- `object_lock` (Boolean) Whether object lock is enabled on the bucket.
- `public_prefixes` (List of String) Key prefixes anyone may read without a key. Empty when wholly private.
- `quota_bytes` (Number) Size limit in bytes; 0 means no limit.
- `region` (String) Region code where the bucket resides, such as "af-abj".
- `size_bytes` (Number) Live stored bytes in the bucket.
- `state` (String) Current bucket state: "provisioning", "active", "updating", "deleting", "failed", or "unknown".
- `tags` (Map of String) Key-value tags set on the bucket.
- `versioning` (Boolean) Whether object versioning is enabled.
